note: Feel numbers that are not physical (physical ones live in reality.json). Camera rows sized against hero.height 1.89 m.

camera.note_follow: follow_rate: 1/s, the pivot's critically damped spring (it trails a steady walk by 2 v / rate); follow_limit: m it may trail; rise_rate: 1/s, the pivot's height toward the floor, slower than across; lead_time: s of velocity the aim looks ahead in a steady run; lead_rate: 1/s, how slowly that lead builds and goes; recentre_after: s of no look input before the yaw drifts behind the real travel; recentre_per_m: rad of drift per rad of error per metre travelled (a leash, so it never turns while the hero stands or pushes a wall)
camera.note_frame: frame_low: share of the frame height the pivot sits below centre when looking level (1/6 is the lower-third line), easing to centred at pitch_min; slope_ahead: m ahead along the view where a ray reads the ground; slope_share: share of that slope the view pitches by; slope_max_deg: the most it pitches. follow_rate and lead_rate also set the lead that cancels the spring's lag in a steady walk (2 v / follow_rate, built at lead_rate)

hop.note: xfade: s of blend between clips; anticipation: s of crouch before take-off, the last part of hop_start plays in it (all 0.34 s of it would delay every press); xfade_hop: s of blend into and out of the hop clips, short so the arc keeps its timing

hero.note: dust_height: m up the boots the dust tint reaches (grit lands within about 7 cm, design/research/dust.md, plus what a step scuffs on); dust_share: how far toward the dust colour at the sole; gait_hysteresis: Froude the hurry-to-walk change sits below hero.froude.walk_run. The boots' sink is reality.json hero.sink

audio.note: The mix (audio/audio.gd). dB on top of the files, which are normalised (loops -20 LUFS, one-shots -3 dBFS peak). range: m, a 3D sound's cut-off, Mars sound 'falters at just 26 feet (8 meters)' (NASA/JPL 2022); unit_size: m where a 3D sound starts to fall away. fade_s: s of the inside/outside crossfade. breath: rest in breaths a minute, a resting adult takes 12 to 18 (MedlinePlus, Vital signs); hard (at the sheet's hurry speed), rise_s and fall_s (time constants: up fast, settling back slowly) and inhale_share (where in a breath the exhale starts) are art direction, never shown to players. wind: ref_speed m/s that plays at wind.db (sky states blow 4 to 6, world.json weather); gust: the swell's share; gust_hz: its slow noise frequency. habitat and machines: world.json item ids. pitch: random spread on one-shots

life.note: The hero's layers on top of its clips (player/hero_life.gd), art direction judged on film; the limits that are physical come from the sheet (hero.lean.max). lean_share: share of the free-body angle atan(a / g) the upper body leans into a push; lean_hz and lean_damping: its spring (under 1 swings a little past upright at a stop); carry_lean_deg: extra forward lean over a carried bag; breath_chest_deg and breath_shoulder_deg: how far the chest tips back and the shoulders rise at a full breath (the clock and rate are audio.breath's); look_waist_deg, look_head_deg, look_pitch_deg: each side, the waist takes most of a turn because a helmet turns with the torso (no sheet row: suited neck and waist ranges were not found); look_rate: 1/s the gaze eases to a new point; look_far: m ahead along the camera's view the gaze rests when nothing is near
